issues.detail: The Hebrew text says 'Jehoiada the priest' (יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Vua thầy tế lễ Giô-ya-đa' which adds 'Vua' (king) before 'thầy tế lễ' (priest), incorrectly identifying Jehoiada as a king. This is an addition that changes the identity of the person.
